script_text: Your confidence gets tested this week, Leo — and the shift won't be subtle. Thursday through Sunday, Mercury direct clears communication fog in your 7th House of partnerships and agreements. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House, sparking love and creative breakthroughs.
